Name: chain_receptor_type
Description: Receptor polymer category: protein, dna, rna, or dna+rna

Name: chain_sequence
Description: Full polymer sequence in one-letter code, keyed by the source asymmetric-chain ID

Name: chain_num_unresolved_residues
Description: Number of unresolved residues (SEQRES length - len(residues))

Name: chain_is_holo
Description: Whether the chain participates in a holo receptor or is excluded from the apo partition

Name: chain_is_ligand_like
Description: Whether this chain is ligand-like rather than an eligible receptor chain

Name: chain_uniprot_ids
Description: UniProt accessions mapped to the chain
